description: Taurus and Cancer compatibility in Western astrology: Earth and Water, fixed and cardinal, the 60° sextile between them, and what helps the pairing.
answer: In Western astrology, Taurus (fixed Earth) and Cancer (cardinal Water) sit 60 degrees apart, a complementary match in which each element feeds the other. Taurus is often described as reliable and patient and Cancer as intuitive and nurturing; Sun signs describe tendencies, not outcomes.

sections.heading: How Taurus and Cancer show up together
paragraphs: Taurus and Cancer are a gentle, home-loving pair who value security, comfort and loyalty. Cancer brings emotional care, Taurus brings practical steadiness, and together they often build a warm nest. The risk is that both resist change and avoid hard conversations.

Taurus tends to love steadily and sensually. The sign is linked with patience and loyalty, so a Taurus partner often builds trust slowly, shows care through comfort and practical reliability, and enjoys shared routines such as meals, music and familiar places. In conversation with Cancer, Taurus tends to be measured and deliberate. It listens, takes its time and prefers to return to a topic once it has thought it through.

Cancer tends to love protectively and deeply. As a Sun sign it is linked with nurturing and emotional memory, so a Cancer partner often creates a sense of home, remembers what matters to people and shows care through attention and looking after them. In conversation with Taurus, Cancer tends to read tone before words and may approach a sensitive subject indirectly, testing whether it is safe to say more.

On first meeting Cancer, Taurus often comes across as calm, warm and grounded, with an unhurried manner that makes people relax. On first meeting Taurus, Cancer often comes across as kind, attentive and a little reserved, warming noticeably once it feels safe. Put together, Taurus brings steadiness and a sense of home, while Cancer brings emotional care and belonging.

sections.heading: Earth meets Water: element and modality
paragraphs: Taurus and Cancer combine Earth and Water, which astrology treats as complementary elements: water nourishes earth. Taurus offers stability and practical care, Cancer offers emotional depth and intuition, so this pairing is often nurturing, loyal and protective. The risk is that Taurus and Cancer both become cautious and inward-looking. An Earth-Water pair like Taurus and Cancer tends to do well when it keeps some outside stimulation in its life.

Cancer is a cardinal sign and Taurus is a fixed sign. Cardinal energy starts things and fixed energy sustains them, so one partner tends to propose and the other to commit and persist. The friction comes when the cardinal sign wants a new direction and the fixed sign wants to stay the course. Both are receptive signs in traditional astrology (Fire and Air are active, Earth and Water receptive), so Taurus and Cancer tend to meet the world with a similar inward, receptive stance. The traditional keywords for Taurus include reliable, patient and practical, and those for Cancer include intuitive, nurturing and protective.

sections.heading: The 60° relationship: sextile
paragraphs: Taurus and Cancer sit two signs apart, 60 degrees, which matches the sextile in traditional astrology. Taurus belongs to an element that complements Cancer's, so Taurus and Cancer usually find it easy to cooperate and talk. A Taurus-Cancer sextile is often described as friendly and supportive, with opportunities that grow when Taurus and Cancer both put in some effort. In practice, Taurus and Cancer tend to reward small, regular effort in each other: shared projects, honest conversation and saying yes to each other's ideas.

Counting from Aries, Taurus is sign 2 and Cancer is sign 4, which is where the 60-degree figure comes from: each sign spans 30 degrees. Taurus is ruled by Venus, the planet astrology links with love, pleasure and values, and Cancer is ruled by the Moon, which astrology links with feelings, memory and care, so a Taurus-Cancer pairing is often read as Venus meeting Moon. For Taurus and Cancer, this is a relationship between whole signs rather than an aspect calculated from two birth charts.

sections.heading: Needs, friction and what helps
paragraphs: With Cancer, Taurus usually needs security, consistency and time to adjust, along with physical affection and a partner who keeps their word. With Taurus, Cancer usually needs emotional safety, reassurance and a partner who treats family and private life as important.

When stressed around Cancer, Taurus can dig in, resist change on principle and go quiet rather than discuss what is wrong. Under stress around Taurus, Cancer can retreat into its shell, become moody or hold on to a hurt long after it seemed resolved. With a cardinal and a fixed sign, one partner usually wants to resolve things quickly while the other needs time to shift position, so a short pause before deciding often helps both.

What helps Cancer with Taurus is advance notice, unhurried time together, and showing reliability over weeks rather than trying to win a point in one evening. What helps Taurus with Cancer is gentleness at the start of hard talks, small reassurances, and honouring family occasions and private rituals. Naming Taurus' resistance to change and Cancer's sensitivity to hurt as patterns, rather than as faults, tends to make them easier to work with, and much easier to laugh about later.

sections.heading: Taurus and Cancer day to day
paragraphs: At home, Taurus tends to invest in comfort, good bedding, a well-stocked kitchen, plants and music, and it appreciates a Cancer who enjoys those pleasures rather than rushing past them. For its part at home, Cancer tends to nest, cooking family recipes, keeping photographs on display and making the space feel safe, and it values a Taurus who treats home as sacred.

As a teammate, Taurus is steady, patient and hard to rattle; alongside a Cancer, it brings follow-through and asks for clear expectations before deadlines move. In turn, as a teammate, Cancer protects colleagues, remembers personal details and senses morale; alongside a Taurus, it works best where loyalty is returned and feelings are respected. Shared projects that use both the reliable side of Taurus and the intuitive side of Cancer, a trip, a renovation, a joint hobby, tend to show this pairing at its best.

In daily rhythm, Taurus and Cancer often create a homely, protective routine with good food and quiet evenings; inviting friends round now and then brings in the outside energy this cosy pairing can lack.

faq.question: Are Taurus and Cancer compatible?
faq.answer: Taurus and Cancer have complementary elements (Earth and Water) and sit 60 degrees apart, a complementary match in which each element feeds the other. Astrology describes themes rather than scores; for Taurus and Cancer, the themes to watch are Taurus' resistance to change and Cancer's sensitivity to hurt.

faq.question: What are the dates and elements of Taurus and Cancer?
faq.answer: In 2026, the Sun is in Taurus from Apr 20 – May 20 and in Cancer from Jun 21 – Jul 22. Taurus is a Fixed Earth sign ruled by Venus; Cancer is a Cardinal Water sign ruled by Moon. Cusp dates can shift by a day between years.

faq.question: What does the 60° angle between Taurus and Cancer mean?
faq.answer: Counting around the zodiac, Cancer sits 60 degrees from Taurus, a sextile in traditional terms. It describes how Taurus and Cancer relate as signs, not an aspect between planets in two people's charts.

faq.question: What might Taurus and Cancer enjoy doing together?
faq.answer: Taurus usually enjoys sensory, unhurried outings: long dinners, wine tastings, gardens, concerts, massages and weekends in beautiful, quiet places, while Cancer usually enjoys intimate, nostalgic outings: home-cooked dinners, beach walks, family visits, cosy cafés and revisiting meaningful places. Alternating who chooses gives both partners a taste of the other's world.
